newsitems.title: Backpack Battles Patch 1.1.9
newsitems.author: playwithfurcifer_business
newsitems.contents:
[h3]Hi everyone, [/h3][p][/p][p]we are back with a [b]crossover item from [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400960/Oaken_Tower/"]Oaken Tower[/url], the Time Pendant![/b][/p][p]At the same time, they added a whole selection of BPB items into their game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/e34db6a90c5fca35b27ca88ec4b02c6ee94a3f4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, we have some balance adjustments.[/p][p]Have fun and see y’all soon! :)[/p][p]
- Doro and Mario[/p][h2]

newsitems.title: ⚙️ENGINEER IS HERE!!⚙️ Patch 1.1 - FREE UPDATE OUT NOW!!
newsitems.author: IndieArk
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Hi everyone! 🎉[/h2][h2]The big Backpack Battles update is READY NOW!
[/h2][p][/p][h3]It comes with a completely new class, the [b]Engineer[/b], which alone has over 40 new items![/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/0c87eeaf1c7724edb62024aa6bd3312a7b9e033d.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]We recently announced the Engineer's release with a trailer:[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="gpgtQRzK3cM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]For the existing classes, we are adding 35 items, including class-specific and neutral [b]recipes[/b], [b]dual class skills[/b] and new [b]treasures[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]Somehow we are at a total of [b]517 items[/b] now…[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/ac49991f2eaa79d6b4a72be86350c18e17320329.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/851359664118370fcdea44e88fba6d32126da98f.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]
We also put in tons of polish and quality-of-life stuff, including the new [b]edit modes[/b] that allow you to edit bags and other items separately and the [b]grid storage[/b] as an alternative view on the storage box.[/h3][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/9d8e7a7955038f31b114260e0bbf4d0706ceba2e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/87a584470c70c34496514e231858bb7614f86cd7.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3][/h3][h3]We are so exited to finally get it out there and hope you will like it! 😊
[/h3][h3]Thank you all for playing our little game![/h3][p][/p][p]You will hear from us soon with the usual fixes and balance adjustments to get the new stuff in line.
[/p][p]Doro and Mario ❤[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Here’s the changelog for 1.1:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]NEW CLASS: Engineer![/p][/*][*][p]35 NEW ITEMS for the other classes[/p][/*][*][p]NEW MODE: Switch Mode (Ranked & Unranked)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggleable toolbar on the bottom of the screen where you can access undo/redo. Pushing items to storage was moved inside the toolbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added modes for [b]only editing bags[/b] and [b]only editing items[/b], where they can be moved freely independent of each other (can be accessed via the toolbar).[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]grid storage mode [/b](can be accessed via the toolbar). Can be zoomed with Ctrl+mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]New Ranking season started - Your new ranks will be determined based on your ranks last season.[/p][/*][*][p]Added text animations for item names (can be toggled in Options).[/p][/*][*][p]Added Keybinds: Undo/Redo, switching between the new inventory edit modes, toggle grid storage (G by default), showing recipe tooltips (Alt by default), open library (Tab by default).[/p][/*][*][p]Combat: The sword icons on the status UI now move according to player/opponent health + Block totals[/p][/*][*][p]History: Now shows rank gains and losses. Added filters for classes and modes. Now only shows the version of a run if it differs from the current game version. Now shows the number of items and the distinct types. History runs can now be marked as opponent with right click.[/p][/*][*][p]Item Library: Ingredients etc. on the info panel can now be spotlighted by clicking them. (also works for recipes shown by pressing Alt) Library can now be zoomed with Ctrl+mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: BGM now has a chance to play the lobby mode track and switch mode track in ranked/unranked mode for variety. Added an animation when an item comes up in the shop that can craft with another item.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Support: Added right stick jumping between points of interest. D-Pad now scrolls scrollbars.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Balancing[/h3][p][u]Neutral[/u][/p][list][*][p]Pandamonium now gives 3% Poison crit chance per ⭐Food[/p][/*][*][p]Holy Spear: Damage -3[/p][/*][*][p]Shelly: Cooldown 12s -> 13s, speed up per Potion 15% -> 20%[/p][/*][*][p]Darksaber: Damage +2[/p][/*][*][p]Bloodthorne: Stamina cost 1.6 -> 1.5[/p][/*][*][p]Shield of Valor: Cost 12g -> 11g[/p][/*][*][p]Serpent Staff: Poison duplication chance 35% -> 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Helm: Critical hit resistance 25% -> 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Vampiric Armor: Health used 45 -> 50, Vampirism 2 -> 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Burning Coal (Armor): Cold resist 6 -> 7[/p][/*][*][p]Frozen Buckler: Stamina removal 0.7 -> 0.8[/p][/*][*][p]Frostbite: Vampirism 7 -> 8[/p][/*][*][p]Ice Armor: Block 80 -> 90[/p][/*][*][p]Fortuna’s Kiss: Cooldown 4s -> 3.5s[/p][/*][*][p]Full Body Protection: Cooldown 4.5s -> 4s[/p][/*][*][p]Spicy Banana: Chance 85% -> 50%, Heat 1 -> 2[/p][/*][*][p]Lil Chestnut: Trade chance 30% -> 40%
